source_row.rationale: Nurse-sensitive quality indicators (such as fall rates, pressure injury incidence, and hospital-acquired infection rates) are outcome measures considered to be directly influenced by the quantity or quality of nursing care, used to evaluate and improve nursing practice and patient safety.
source_row.source_detail: Nurse-sensitive indicators are outcomes influenced by nursing care, including falls and pressure injuries; reviewed 2026-08-14.
source_row.stem: A hospital tracks specific quality indicators, such as fall rates and pressure injury incidence, that are considered directly influenced by nursing care, and a physician colleague assumes these numbers mainly reflect medical rather than nursing decisions.
